title: Isoclinic groups and conjugacy quandles
summary: We show that two finite isoclinic groups of the same order have isomorphic conjugacy quandles. We also show that the converse hold under some assumptions on the groups. It happens that isoclinsim of group of the same order is equivalent to having isomorphic quandles for groups of order $n<128$. We construct two non isoclinic groups of order $128$ having isomorphic conjugacy quandles.
